sections.description: Education Shop is a clean, modern, and fully responsive education WordPress theme built as a child theme of the popular Bizberg WordPress Theme, thoughtfully crafted for tuition centers, online course hubs, universities, colleges, schools, workshops, training centers, bookshops, eCommerce stores, and any educational institution looking to establish a professional online presence. Perfectly suited for marketing educational products, bookselling, blogging, or running an online shop with WooCommerce, this free WordPress eLearning or LMS theme is fully compatible with LearnPress — the leading WordPress LMS plugin — making it an excellent solution for managing courses, lessons, and students online. Built on the solid Bootstrap framework, Education Shop is cross-browser compatible, translation-ready, and SEO friendly, helping you reach more learners and rank higher in search results. With full Elementor page builder support, you can customize every section effortlessly using simple drag-and-drop editing — no coding required. Should you need any help, you can rely on extensive documentation and a friendly support team to guide you. Whether you’re setting up an online course marketplace, an education-focused eCommerce shop, or a training center website, Education Shop provides a flexible, user-friendly, and powerful foundation to grow your educational venture online.
